verdict.rationale: Brex offers webhooks that fire on events (brex-docs-1, brex-docs-25, brex-docs-35) plus built-in policy rules that auto-trigger actions like blocking out-of-policy spend, auto-approving low-risk expenses, and escalating exceptions (brex-docs-8, brex-docs-9, brex-docs-16, brex-docs-36, brex-docs-41). Third-party integrations (Zapier, Workato, Pipedream) extend this into custom event-triggered automations (brex-docs-30, brex-docs-31, brex-docs-32). Missing for 10: a native no-code rule-builder UI for arbitrary custom triggers/actions beyond preset expense/travel/approval policies, and independent hands-on confirmation that webhook-to-action automations work reliably in practice.
